title: Recently declined the top product -- cooldown rule excludes it from being offered again so soon

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Omar -- how can I help today?
Hi, I'm calling about a trip I'm planning next month, wanted to check a few things on my account.
Happy to help with that -- what's on your mind?
Mostly just making sure my card will work abroad, and whether there's anything useful for travellers.
Good question -- let me check what fits your account for a trip like that.
Appreciate it. I did get offered something a little while ago but it wasn't the right fit at the time.
That's useful context, thank you -- let me make sure whatever I suggest now actually fits.
Sounds good, thanks for checking rather than just repeating the same thing.
Of course -- here's what I'd suggest for your trip.
Glad it helps -- thanks for calling, have a great trip!
